figure.title: Two distinct clock mappings for meta-order delivery and impact
figure.panel_a_title: Route A — Calendar-time delivery of one event-time meta-order
figure.panel_b_title: Route B — Subordinated reduced Abel impact response
figure.clarification: The panels illustrate separate clock mappings of different native objects: cumulative delivery in Route A and reduced impact in Route B. They are not composed, and no pointwise correspondence between their curves is imposed.
